title: ExceptionalFiniteRealization
statement: In the ambient strict-system realization [def-pur-adic-exceptional-system-realization] of the actual exceptional construction [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], identify the lifted uniformizer quotient with the lifted original finite coefficient ring by the quotient ring equivalence. Realize ordinary etale modules in fixed scalar coordinates by this equivalence and constant scalar restriction; this realization is additive and an exact equivalence. Its comparison with ordinary direct image is the unique map equal to the recorded underlying-set map on every section. The inverse-image comparison is its adjunction mate, characterized by the full Hom-transpose equation. The derived direct-image comparison is uniquely characterized by the universal right-derived-unit square on all cochain complexes.

proof.text: Forgetting commutativity preserves local injectivity and local surjectivity; hence it preserves the sheafification local equivalences on the small etale site.

Realization is the composite of scalar restriction along the constant-ring comparison isomorphism, the constant-ring module-sheaf equivalence, and fixed-ring restriction along the explicit quotient equivalence. Construct the inverse of the first scalar restriction sectionwise. All three factors are additive equivalences, hence exact.

Use the recorded rightUnderlying isomorphism on sections. Its adjunction transpose expresses it by the ordinary inverse-image unit, the lifted module comparison, and the module counit. The moduleAdd and moduleSMul equations show that the section map is additive and respects constant scalars; the explicit quotient equivalence gives linearity in the fixed coordinates. Sectionwise bijectivity gives an isomorphism, and the prescribed section equation gives uniqueness.

Take the inverse mate of the normalized direct-image isomorphism. Equivalences make this mate invertible; its transpose is exactly the required Hom equation. Evaluate at an identity arrow and use injectivity of the Hom transpose to prove uniqueness.
Use the split existence and uniqueness components for the universal right-derived-unit square; assemble them into the unique normalized derived direct-image comparison.

proof_origin.place: Finite coefficient realization: scalar restriction, sectionwise normalized ordinary comparison, its inverse mate, and split existence/uniqueness interfaces for the universal right-derived comparison.
